name: DRB-HICOM Berhad
summary: DRB-HICOM Berhad engages in automotive, aerospace and defence, banking, postal, services, and properties businesses. It manufactures, assembles, distributes, imports, leases, and sells passenger and commercial vehicles, motorcycles, and related spare parts and services. The company maintains, markets, refurbishes or retrofits military and commercial vehicles, equipment, and spare parts; builds, develops, leases, rents, manages, and invests in properties; constructs, operates, and maintains infrastructure and broadcast systems; and manages billboards.
